title: Norwegian Beef Stew
description: Hearty and comforting, this Norwegian beef stew is made with tender beef, flavorful vegetables, and a hint of Norwegian flair. It's a perfect meal for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add beef broth, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Return beef to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2-3 hours or until beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
